name: econ-earth-buy
notes: No buying from Earth (user, 2026-10-13). Vanilla prices a missing space resource as boost + money from Earth for the aliens too. If the aliens really pay it, their boost income is spent as it arrives (stock ~0, as in every run so far); with the mod they can't, so boost accumulates and shortfalls are refused. Run on vanilla first: if alien boost income is 0, vanilla never actually buys and the switch only guards the lore. Also checks the widening wormhole (2026-10-13): vanilla drip in the 2034 fixture is 40/month; at Normal, 0.05/year over ~8 campaign years gives ~1.4x.
